verdict.rationale: Gusto documents a single day-one business bank account (early beta, via Increase Bank) and a Money Dashboard for cash-flow visibility. Because it now offers banking, the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes multiple checking sub-accounts or rules that automatically split incoming deposits across them, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can open multiple checking sub-accounts and auto-allocate incoming deposits across them
